# `damage_type`

A kind of harm, with the resistance of anything that states none of its own (02 §12.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `default_resist` (object [`ResistSpec`](#resistspec), or `null`; optional): The resistance of anything that does not state its own. Default: no threshold, factor 1.
- `kinetic` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether this is the type bodies and falling masses deliver. At most one loaded damage type may say so (02 §23).
- `devastation` (string, or `null`; optional): The kind of devastation this type leaves (02 §17.2). Stored as written until that definition type exists.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Free-form tags.
- `severs` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether a hit of this type that goes through a body part across its whole width takes the part off (06 §7.2). Read by the body model; the world gives it no meaning.

<a id="resistspec"></a>
### `ResistSpec`

How a material or element resists one damage type (02 §5.4, §12.2).

- `threshold` (a pressure as a number in SI units or a string with a unit; **required**): Intensity below which the damage type does nothing.
- `factor` (number; optional): Multiplier on the energy that gets through. Default 1.
